Services & capabilities

Everything between
the drawing and the shipment.

Design and engineering, connector manufacturing, cable and harness assembly, PCBA and full system assembly – five disciplines under one group, so a product never has to change hands mid-way.

What we do

Five disciplines, one production chain.

Cable & Harness

Custom assemblies from high-mix low-volume to mass production, with 300+ operators.

Design & Engineering

From requirements gathering to certification – a structured, five-stage process.

Connector Manufacturing

More than 15 years of joint development with Kenpol.

PCBA

Prototype through mass production, with SPI, AOI and X-ray.

System Assembly

Finished systems and products, with planning built for complex projects.

Why it matters

One supplier means one accountability.

The collaborative and adaptive assembly process allows us to work closely with our partners to create tailored solutions that align with their product requirements.

Customer satisfaction is the cornerstone of our business. Our management team provides support at every stage of the process, from initial consultation to post-sale assistance.

ISO 9001Quality management, certified at every factory in the group
ISO 13485Medical devices – ISO 13485:2016
AS9100DThe aerospace industry quality standard
